device_entry.name: Andor科学相机
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: Andor科学相机是一类实验室成像设备，用于采集低噪声、高灵敏度的二维图像数据，常见于显微成像、光谱检测和一般科研实验中的图像记录与数据采集。
device_entry.description_en: An Andor scientific camera is a laboratory imaging device used to acquire low-noise, high-sensitivity 2D image data. It is commonly used for microscopy, spectroscopy detection, and general scientific image acquisition in research experiments.
